Method of Attack: Two-stage destructive malware attack combining an MBRLocker that overwrites the Master Boot Record to display a ransom note and a data-destroying malware that overwrites targeted files with static data
Stage1.exe overwrites MBR preventing OS boot and displays ransom note demanding $10,000 bitcoin payment
Stage2.exe downloads and executes data-corrupting malware (Tbopbh.jpg) that overwrites files with 0xCC bytes and renames them with random extensions
No decryption key input method provided, indicating destructive fake ransomware
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with affected Master Boot Record and targeted file extensions
Attack Vector: Execution of stage1.exe from local folders (C:\PerfLogs, C:\ProgramData, C:\, or C:\temp)
Simultaneous execution of stage2.exe to download and run destructive payload from Discord
Indicators of Compromise: Tox chat ID in ransom note: 8BEDC411012A33BA34F49130D0F186993C6A32DAD8976F6A5D82C1ED23054C057ECED5496F65
